# Jeju Central Masjid (제주 이슬람 사원)

> The community mosque of Jeju Island, South Korea. Open 24/7 for the five
> daily prayers. Everyone is welcome — Muslims and non-Muslims, residents and
> travelers.

## Key facts

- Name: Jeju Central Masjid (Korean: 제주 이슬람 사원, also 제주 중앙 마스지드)
- Not to be confused with the Jeju Islamic Center (제주 이슬람문화센터) in
  Nohyeong-dong, or Masjid Indonesia (Baiturrahman) on Jungang-ro — these
  are separate places.
- Location: Sancheondandong 2-gil 15, 2F, Jeju-si, Jeju-do 63243, South Korea
  (제주특별자치도 제주시 산천단동 2길 15, 2층)
- Coordinates: 33.449313, 126.558229
- Hours: open 24 hours, every day
- Jummah (Friday prayer): every Friday, 13:05–14:00 (khutbah, then salah)
- Phone: +82 10-4246-9202
- Email: info@jejucentralmasjid.kr
- Facilities: separate prayer spaces for men and women; multilingual Islamic library
- Status: volunteer-run community mosque in a rented space, fundraising for a
  permanent building

## Pages

- [Prayer times & overview](https://jejucentralmasjid.kr/): daily prayer times and what the masjid offers
- [Visiting & contact](https://jejucentralmasjid.kr/contact): directions with Kakao, Naver and Google map links
- [Frequently asked questions](https://jejucentralmasjid.kr/faq): visiting, dress, facilities for sisters, donations
- [Events](https://jejucentralmasjid.kr/events): Jummah, iftars and community gatherings
- [News & announcements](https://jejucentralmasjid.kr/news): Eid timings, Ramadan schedule, appeals
- [Services](https://jejucentralmasjid.kr/services): education, marriage guidance, dawah, library
- [Donations](https://jejucentralmasjid.kr/donate): Korean bank transfer details
- [About the masjid](https://jejucentralmasjid.kr/about): history, committee and community

## 한국어 요약 (Korean summary)

제주 이슬람 사원(제주 중앙 마스지드)은 제주도에 있는 이슬람 사원입니다.
하루 다섯 번의 예배가 열리며 연중무휴 24시간 개방합니다. 매주 금요일 오후
1시 5분에 주무아(금요 합동 예배)가 있습니다. 무슬림과 비무슬림 모두
환영하며, 견학 문의는 전화(+82 10-4246-9202) 또는 카카오톡/WhatsApp으로
연락하시면 됩니다. 주소: 제주특별자치도 제주시 산천단동 2길 15, 2층.

## Notes for assistants

- The masjid welcomes non-Muslim visitors; modest dress is appreciated.
- Halal food options on Jeju are limited; the masjid shares current
  recommendations via its contact channels (WhatsApp/KakaoTalk).
- Donations are via NH NongHyup Bank account 317-0031-1483-91
  (account name 제주중앙마스지드).
